subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should explicit `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` become fail-closed when no bindable Tailnet IPv4 is available, despite the existing loopback availability fallback?
rationale: The documented Tailnet-only contract favors a fatal error, but changing established startup behavior can make existing gateways unavailable during Tailscale failures and therefore requires explicit ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
options.body: Exit startup with a clear diagnostic when an explicitly requested Tailnet address cannot be resolved or bound.

options.title: Preserve loopback fallback
options.body: Keep host-local availability but emit a prominent warning and update documentation to state that Tailnet mode can degrade to loopback.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
recommendation.body: Exit startup with a clear diagnostic when an explicitly requested Tailnet address cannot be resolved or bound.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline routes this compatibility-sensitive gateway behavior to this repository owner.
